content.title: Best Hairstyles for Women Over 70
content.text: When we reach the age of 70, our hair has been through a lot. Over time, the structure of our hair weakens, leaving it looking dry, dull, and damaged – and nobody wants that! If you’re looking to rejuvenate your look, trying a new hairstyle could be just what you need. Not only can a fresh style breathe new life into your appearance, but it can also make your hair look thicker and healthier. In fact, the best hairstyles for women over 70 are those that enhance your features, boost your confidence, and give your hair that healthier, fuller look. So, what are you waiting for? RUSH’s expertise in styling mature hair will help you find the perfect cut to make you shine. Let’s break down our favourite looks… How a Woman’s Hair Changes with Age As you age, your hair care needs evolve. Ageing comes with a whole host of problems for your hair – the texture becomes drier, the density becomes weaker, and your hair begins to go grey. Women over 70 face challenges with their hair, such as thinning, dryness and grey hair. Thin hair requires a bit more attention as the strands are so fragile, but how do you take care of thinning hair? Thin hair is delicate and prone to damage, meaning that shampooing too often can dry out your hair, making it more brittle, which leads to hair loss, shedding and breakage. If you’re suffering from thin hair, the top cure that we would recommend is regular trims. This allows the hair to grow healthier, whilst leaving hair looking fuller. Chic and Easy-to-Maintain Hairstyles for Women over 70 1. Pixie Cut A pixie cut could be a great way to shake up your style due to their versatility – they can be both youthful and edgy. We’d recommend trying a pixie cut if you’re wanting to accentuate your face’s features! As you age, the structure of the hair is weakened so shorter cuts will help your hair to look healthier and fuller. 2. Classic Bob A bob is a wonderful option if you’re wanting to add a youthful touch to your look, as it complements almost any face shape and accentuates your face’s features. This is the ultimate cut if you’re looking for a chic and sophisticated look. Adding a side parting will help to add volume and dimension to this look. 3. Soft Curls Soft curls can suit you at almost any age – and they will always look glamourous. This style is loved for its romantic, timeless appeal and can be easily achieved by using heatless curls. 4. Layered Cut A layered cut adds texture and dimension to the classic cut, which is especially handy if you have thin or fine hair. Why not add a set of bangs to draw attention to frame the face – this will really make the look pop and draw attention to your features. 5. Short Shag with a Fringe A short shag with a fringe is a trendy and edgy style to shake up your look – and it’s one of the most popular looks of 2024. This boho look will definitely turn heads! Hairstyles for Thinning Hair 1. Textured Bob Wispy, layered, textured bobs are perfect as they accentuate the face’s features as they draw attention to the face’s focal points. This cut can be elevated with bangs to harmonise your face shape and feature. This is a great cut for those with thinner hair to give the illusion of fuller hair. 2. Voluminous Lob A classic tapered cut is loved for their sleek and timeless appearance. This cut looks great on women over 70 thanks to their low maintenance effortless nature – we’d recommend trying this out if you’re wanting to give the illusion of thicker hair. 3. Curly Pixie A curly pixie is the height of playfulness. A curly pixie cut could be a great way to shake up your style due to their versatility – they can be both youthful and edgy. We’d recommend trying a pixie cut if you’re wanting to accentuate your face’s features! As you age, the structure of the hair is weakened so shorter cuts will help your hair to look healthier and fuller. 4. Feathered Layers Feathered layers are perfect to add fullness to the hair and add texture and definition to give the illusion of fuller hair. This cut can be elevated with bangs to harmonise your face shape and feature. 5. Wispy Bangs Layered cuts with wispy fringe are perfect to accentuate your face’s features. This cut can be elevated with wispy bangs to harmonise your face shape and feature. This cut consists of short face-framing layers that swoop outwards – a gorgeous look for if you’re wanting to add a youthful touch. Hairstyles to Embrace Natural Grey 1. Silver Pixie There’s nothing more sleek than a silver pixie – an elegant and a timeless classic. This is a great option for women who are wanting to age gracefully. 2. Grey Bob The grey bob is one of the most polished looks for women over 70 and is loved for its sleek and timeless nature – and an added bonus is it’s very low-maintenance. 3. Long and Flowing Grey Long and flowing hair is a sign of beauty and elegance, and a great way to embrace your hair turning grey. As you get older, having long hair is a blessing! 4. Salt and Pepper Layers Salt and pepper layers are a great way to shake up your hair when it’s turning grey. The hints of grey will add texture and dimension to your cut whilst giving the illusion of thicker, healthier looking hair. 5. Sassy Grey Tapered Cut Tapered cuts are loved for their sleek and elegant appearance – this style looks great on women over 70 thanks to their low maintenance and effortless nature! If you’re wanting to add a touch of class to your style then this is the look for you.
